proposal.reason: Main change is a substantive rewrite of the IB network backend connection/handshake path (Connect/Accept readiness, QP metadata/ECE negotiation, FLID/subnet routing, traffic-class handling, receive-size reporting, and NET v6-compatible behavior). Added gin because GIN-specific IB connection/listen-close/cancel flows were independently changed in both gin_host and net_ib/gin integration. Added memory because the PR introduces a per-device, refcounted MR registration cache with new registration/deregistration ownership semantics.
